audit_title: EURUSD Spot Market Data vs. IQ Option Blitz Contract Mechanics

items.details: EURUSD spot candles are assigned active_id 1 on IQ Option websocket API.
items.research_impact: All 62,371 development candles correspond to authentic active_id 1 spot quotes.

items.details: Blitz options on EURUSD use symbol 'EURUSD_OP' and reference active_id 1861.
items.research_impact: EURUSD spot (1) and EURUSD_OP (1861) are distinct API entities.

items.details: Redacted practice record demonstrates a fixed 30.0-second option holding duration.
items.research_impact: Option duration (30s) differs from the 60s candle duration modeled in Phase 30.

items.details: Phase 30 models train strictly on 60s EURUSD candle OPEN-to-CLOSE differences.
items.research_impact: No option contracts, option payouts, or option Greeks were ever in training data.

items.details: Unverified whether Blitz strike is set to spot bid, ask, mid, or delayed internal index at order time.
items.research_impact: Assumed zero-spread strike matching candle open is an unsupported assumption.

items.details: Unverified whether payout is fixed (e.g. 70%, 85%, 95%) or fluctuates dynamically.
items.research_impact: Hypothetical economic models with fixed 70% or 95% payouts are illustrative only.

items.details: Unverified whether expiration exactly at strike returns refund, loss, or partial.
items.research_impact: Model must report economics under both refund and loss scenarios without favoring.

items.evidence_source: Public marketing PDFs (unverified live wire format)
items.details: Unverified whether EURUSD_OP quotes match spot EURUSD in real-time or carry dealer spreads/skew.
items.research_impact: Directional edge on spot candles does NOT imply profitability on Blitz options.

items.details: Order processing latency and entry price slippage on the broker server are completely unobserved.
items.research_impact: Prospective signals cannot be traded without verified order routing and execution.

synthesis.core_finding: The research system operates strictly on authentic EURUSD spot candles (active_id 1). Blitz options (EURUSD_OP, active_id 1861) represent a distinct financial instrument whose strike placement, dynamic payouts, tie settlement, and dealer spread remain completely unverified. Directional claims on spot candles cannot be translated to Blitz options.
